source.expression:
let
    Source = Sql.Database(
        "DESKTOP-GEUMHVT\SQLEXPRESS",
        "OlistSalesDW"
    ),
    dw_DimCustomer = Source{[Schema="dw",Item="DimCustomer"]}[Data]
in
    dw_DimCustomer

tables.name: DimCustomerGeography
tables.description: Customer location. Filters all four facts through DimCustomer. Independent from seller location.

columns.name: Customer Region
columns.description: IBGE five-region grouping of approximate ZIP-lookup states. Unknown remains explicit. Display-only attribute; no relationship or source-data change.
columns.expression: VAR StateCode = UPPER(TRIM(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState])) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), StateCode IN {"AC","AP","AM","PA","RO","RR","TO"}, "North", StateCode IN {"AL","BA","CE","MA","PB","PE","PI","RN","SE"}, "Northeast", StateCode IN {"DF","GO","MT","MS"}, "Central-West", StateCode IN {"ES","MG","RJ","SP"}, "Southeast", StateCode IN {"PR","RS","SC"}, "South", "Unknown")

columns.name: Customer City State
columns.description: Display label combining approximate city with state, so same-named cities across states are not merged into one category.

measures.name: Item Revenue
measures.description: All-status item revenue. Do not add to FactOrders merchandise revenue: they represent the same revenue at different grains.

measures.name: Sales Revenue
measures.description: Sales-eligible item revenue. Supports product and seller slicing.

measures.name: Orders With Items
measures.description: Distinct orders represented by the selected items. Supports product and seller filters; nonadditive across these groups.

measures.name: Sales Orders With Items
measures.description: Distinct sales-eligible orders with selected items.

measures.name: Average Sales Order Value
measures.description: Selected eligible item revenue divided by distinct eligible orders with selected items.

measures.name: Item Freight
measures.description: Freight at item grain. Do not add to order-grain FreightAmount.

measures.name: Total Items Sold
measures.description: Eligible order-item records in the current context. One source row is one item; no invented quantity. Supports product, seller and customer geography filters.

measures.name: Average Revenue per Item
measures.description: Eligible merchandise revenue divided by eligible item records. Excludes freight and is not average order value.

measures.name: Selling Products
measures.description: Distinct known products present in eligible selected item records. Excludes ProductKey=0, the source warehouse unknown dimension member; does not exclude its revenue from Sales Revenue.

measures.name: Active Sellers
measures.description: Distinct known sellers present in eligible selected item records. Excludes SellerKey=0, the source warehouse unknown dimension member. This is observed sales activity, not registered sellers.

measures.name: Category Revenue Share
measures.description: Category revenue divided by all selected category revenue, preserving year and geography. Use in the all-category contribution table without a Top N visual filter, so the denominator is not renormalized to only winners.

measures.name: Show Top 10 Categories
measures.description: Visual inclusion flag. Top min(10, available) categories by revenue, with category ascending as deterministic tie-breaker. Apply equals 1 only on the Top 10 category chart.
measures.expression: VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__Revenue", [Sales Revenue]), NOT ISBLANK([__Revenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Revenue], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentCategory) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentCategory), 1, 0)

measures.name: Show Top 10 Products
measures.description: Visual inclusion flag. Top min(10, available) products by eligible revenue with ProductKey ascending tie-breaker. ProductKey is the categorical axis; use measure-only tooltips to avoid raw ProductID grouping filters.
measures.expression: VAR CurrentProduct = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[ProductKey]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[ProductKey]), "__Revenue", [Sales Revenue]), NOT ISBLANK([__Revenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Revenue], DESC, DimProduct[ProductKey], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentProduct) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimProduct[ProductKey], CurrentProduct), 1, 0)

measures.name: Show Top 10 Sellers
measures.description: Visual inclusion flag. Top min(10, available) sellers by eligible revenue with SellerKey ascending tie-breaker. Use the same equals-1 flag on the seller bar chart and comparison table.
measures.expression: VAR CurrentSeller = SELECTEDVALUE(DimSeller[SellerKey]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimSeller[SellerKey]), "__Revenue", [Sales Revenue]), NOT ISBLANK([__Revenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Revenue], DESC, DimSeller[SellerKey], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentSeller) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimSeller[SellerKey], CurrentSeller), 1, 0)

measures.name: Show Top 5 Trend Categories
measures.description: Trend inclusion flag; ranks categories over the current selected period and removes the individual month axis filter. Requires YearMonth on the axis. Verify constant category membership across months after integration.
measures.expression: VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__PeriodRevenue", CALCULATE([Sales Revenue], ALLSELECTED(DimDate[YearMonth], DimDate[MonthStartDate]))), NOT ISBLANK([__PeriodRevenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(5, Candidates, [__PeriodRevenue], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentCategory) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentCategory), 1, 0)

columns.name: Delivery Timeliness
columns.description: Calendar-date SLA classification. Not eligible includes undelivered or missing-date orders; never relabel them late.
columns.expression: IF(FactOrders[OnTimeEligible] = TRUE(), IF(FactOrders[IsOnTime] = TRUE(), "On time", "Late"), "Not eligible")

columns.name: Delivery Duration Band
columns.description: Elapsed-day duration bins, only for duration-eligible orders. Prefixes preserve chronological sort.
columns.expression: IF(FactOrders[DurationEligible] <> TRUE(), BLANK(), SWITCH(TRUE(), FactOrders[DeliveryDurationDays] < 7, "01 | Under 7 days", FactOrders[DeliveryDurationDays] < 14, "02 | 7 to <14 days", FactOrders[DeliveryDurationDays] < 21, "03 | 14 to <21 days", FactOrders[DeliveryDurationDays] < 30, "04 | 21 to <30 days", "05 | 30+ days"))

measures.name: Order Count
measures.description: Order-grain count. Responds to customer, status, purchase date and order; product/seller filters apply only to item measures.

measures.name: Sales Order Count
measures.description: Sales-eligible orders at order grain.

measures.name: On Time Delivery Rate
measures.description: Eligible on-time orders divided by eligible delivered orders; excludes missing/ineligible delivery records.

measures.name: Average Delivery Days
measures.description: Average duration over duration-eligible orders only.

measures.name: Unique Sales Customers
measures.description: Distinct known CustomerUniqueID identities with sales-eligible orders in the current selection. Filters FactOrders first, then transfers its customer keys to DimCustomer with TREATAS. Not distinct CustomerID, not unfiltered dimension population.
measures.expression: VAR EligibleCustomerKeys = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(FactOrders[CustomerKey]), KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[SalesEligible] = TRUE())) RETURN COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(EligibleCustomerKeys, DimCustomer[CustomerKey])), KEEPFILTERS(DimCustomer[CustomerKey] <> 0), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID]))), 0)

measures.name: Repeat Sales Customers
measures.description: Known customer identities with at least two distinct sales-eligible OrderKey values within the current selected dates and geography. Observed repeat purchasing, not cohort retention or lifetime behavior.
measures.expression: VAR IdentityOrders = CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZE(FactOrders, DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID], "__Orders", DISTINCTCOUNT(FactOrders[OrderKey])), KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[SalesEligible] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS(DimCustomer[CustomerKey] <> 0), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID]))) RETURN COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(IdentityOrders, [__Orders] >= 2)), 0)

measures.name: One-Time Sales Customers
measures.description: Identities with exactly one eligible purchase in the current selection. One-time refers only to this selected observation window, not first-ever purchase or churn.

measures.name: Repeat Customer Rate
measures.description: Repeat eligible identities divided by all known eligible identities within the current selection. Nonadditive across geography and time; not a retention rate.

measures.name: Customer Order Frequency
measures.description: Sales-eligible order count for known identities divided by unique eligible identities, within the selected observation window.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Sales Order Count], KEEPFILTERS(DimCustomer[CustomerKey] <> 0), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID]))), [Unique Sales Customers])

measures.name: Sales Revenue per Customer
measures.description: Eligible item revenue associated with known customer identities divided by distinct eligible identities. Preserves item-grain Sales Revenue; never sums order revenue into item revenue.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Sales Revenue], KEEPFILTERS(DimCustomer[CustomerKey] <> 0), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomer[CustomerUniqueID]))), [Unique Sales Customers])

measures.name: Customer States with Sales
measures.description: Distinct nonblank approximate ZIP-lookup states with known eligible customer identities in the current selection. Unknown geography is retained in other visuals but is not counted as a state.

measures.name: Top Customer State
measures.description: Approximate customer state with the highest eligible item revenue in the current selection; deterministic alphabetical tie-break. Blank when there are no positive-revenue known states.
measures.expression: VAR StateRevenue = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]), "__Revenue", [Sales Revenue]), NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) && [__Revenue] > 0) RETURN CONCATENATEX(TOPN(1, StateRevenue, [__Revenue], DESC, DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], ASC), DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], ", ")

measures.name: Top Customer State Revenue
measures.description: Revenue of the top nonblank approximate customer state in the current selection; supporting tooltip for Top Customer State.

measures.name: Customer Region Revenue Share
measures.description: Regional eligible revenue divided by revenue across the selected visible regions, preserving purchase-date, state and city slicers. Requires the proposed Customer Region display attribute.
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Sales Revenue], CALCULATE([Sales Revenue], ALLSELECTED(DimCustomerGeography[Customer Region])))

measures.name: Show Top 10 Customer Cities
measures.description: Visual-only exact Top 10 city/state groups by eligible Sales Revenue within slicer selection, alphabetical tie-break. Use filter equals1 only on city visual, never page/report. Do not add other geography fields as tooltip grouping columns.
measures.expression: VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimCustomerGeography[Customer City State]), "__Revenue", [Sales Revenue]), [__Revenue] > 0) VAR Leaders = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Revenue], DESC, DimCustomerGeography[Customer City State], ASC) VAR ThisCity = SELECTEDVALUE(DimCustomerGeography[Customer City State]) RETURN IF(ISINSCOPE(DimCustomerGeography[Customer City State]) && CONTAINS(Leaders, DimCustomerGeography[Customer City State], ThisCity), 1, 0)

measures.name: Delivered Orders
measures.description: All orders whose status is delivered. This includes delivered orders missing actual delivery dates; SLA eligibility is a separate denominator.

measures.name: Timeliness Eligible Orders
measures.description: Delivered orders with actual and estimated delivery timestamps, using the preserved warehouse eligibility contract.

measures.name: On Time Deliveries
measures.description: Eligible orders delivered on or before estimated calendar date; preserves the original KPI.

measures.name: Late Deliveries
measures.description: Eligible delivered orders after the estimated calendar date. Undelivered orders never enter this count.

measures.name: Late Delivery Rate
measures.description: Late deliveries / timeliness-eligible deliveries under the current filters.

measures.name: Delivered Freight Amount
measures.description: Sum the once-per-order aggregated freight for delivered orders. Never join freight to reviews or items for this measure.

measures.name: Average Freight per Delivered Order
measures.description: Delivered order freight divided by all delivered orders, including zero-freight orders.

measures.name: Average Late Delay Days
measures.description: Mean calendar-day lateness among eligible late orders. Different from elapsed purchase-to-delivery duration.
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(FILTER(FactOrders, FactOrders[OnTimeEligible] = TRUE() && FactOrders[IsOnTime] = FALSE()), INT(FactOrders[ActualDeliveryTimestamp]) - INT(FactOrders[EstimatedDeliveryTimestamp]))

measures.name: Duration Eligible Orders
measures.description: Delivered orders with valid chronology and usable purchase and actual timestamps, matching the existing duration contract.

measures.name: Category On Time Delivery Rate
measures.description: Distinct order-key semijoin from items to orders. A multi-category order contributes once to each applicable category; categories are non-additive.
measures.expression: VAR OrdersInCategory = VALUES(FactOrderItems[OrderKey]) RETURN CALCULATE([On Time Delivery Rate], KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(OrdersInCategory, FactOrders[OrderKey])))

measures.name: Category Eligible Deliveries
measures.description: Timeliness denominator within each category using a distinct order-key semijoin.
measures.expression: VAR OrdersInCategory = VALUES(FactOrderItems[OrderKey]) RETURN CALCULATE([Timeliness Eligible Orders], KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(OrdersInCategory, FactOrders[OrderKey])))

measures.name: Show Delivery Top 10 States
measures.description: Visual-only exact Top 10 by selected population volume; alphabetical tie-break. Never apply at page/report level.
measures.expression: VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]), "__Volume", [Delivered Orders]), NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) && [__Volume] > 0) VAR Leaders = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Volume], DESC, DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], ASC) VAR CurrentGroup = SELECTEDVALUE(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) RETURN IF(ISINSCOPE(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) && CONTAINS(Leaders, DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], CurrentGroup), 1, 0)

measures.name: Show Delivery Top 10 Categories
measures.description: Visual-only exact Top 10 by selected population volume; alphabetical tie-break. Never apply at page/report level.
measures.expression: VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__Volume", [Category Eligible Deliveries]), NOT ISBLANK(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) && [__Volume] > 0) VAR Leaders = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Volume], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) VAR CurrentGroup = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) RETURN IF(ISINSCOPE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) && CONTAINS(Leaders, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentGroup), 1, 0)

measures.name: Payment Amount
measures.description: Payment-grain amount. Includes its own business scope; not product/seller-attributed revenue.

measures.name: Review Count
measures.description: Count of loaded review rows. ReviewID is not unique; no deduplication was applied.

measures.name: Average Review Score
measures.description: Average across valid review rows. Not an average of customer or order averages.

measures.name: Total Valid Reviews
measures.description: All valid loaded review rows, all order statuses. Retains multiple reviews per order and transfers order timeliness selections without item-row expansion. Referential integrity requires every review order to exist.

measures.name: Satisfaction Average Review Score
measures.description: Mean valid review row score across all statuses; order-key semijoin makes timeliness cross-filtering explicit. Same unfiltered population as the original Average Review Score.

measures.name: Positive Review Rate
measures.description: Scores 4 or 5 / all valid reviews in current selection. A score slicer intentionally changes the denominator; score 3 is neutral.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Valid Reviews], KEEPFILTERS(FactReviews[ReviewScore] >= 4)), 0), [Total Valid Reviews])

measures.name: Negative Review Rate
measures.description: Scores 1 or 2 / all valid reviews in current selection. A score slicer intentionally changes the denominator; score 3 is neutral.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Valid Reviews], KEEPFILTERS(FactReviews[ReviewScore] <= 2)), 0), [Total Valid Reviews])

measures.name: Five Star Review Rate
measures.description: Score 5 / all valid reviews in current selection. A score slicer intentionally changes the denominator; score 3 is neutral.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Valid Reviews], KEEPFILTERS(FactReviews[ReviewScore] = 5)), 0), [Total Valid Reviews])

measures.name: On Time Average Review Score
measures.description: Average valid review row score for timeliness-eligible on-time orders, retaining review-date/geography/score filters.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Satisfaction Average Review Score], KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[OnTimeEligible] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[IsOnTime] = TRUE()))

measures.name: Late Average Review Score
measures.description: Average valid review row score for timeliness-eligible late orders, retaining review-date/geography/score filters.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Satisfaction Average Review Score], KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[OnTimeEligible] = TRUE()), KEEPFILTERS(FactOrders[IsOnTime] = FALSE()))

measures.name: Late vs On Time Review Score
measures.description: Display late / on-time means; N/A if either comparison group is absent. Association does not establish causation.
measures.expression: VAR LateScore = [Late Average Review Score] VAR OnTimeScore = [On Time Average Review Score] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(LateScore) || ISBLANK(OnTimeScore), "N/A", FORMAT(LateScore, "0.00") & " / " & FORMAT(OnTimeScore, "0.00"))

measures.name: Category Average Review Score
measures.description: Valid review rows for orders containing a category; each review counted once per category using a distinct order-key semijoin. Multi-category orders can appear in several categories. No item-level attribution is claimed.
measures.expression: VAR OrdersInCategory = VALUES(FactOrderItems[OrderKey]) RETURN CALCULATE([Satisfaction Average Review Score], KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(OrdersInCategory, FactReviews[OrderKey])))

measures.name: Category Valid Reviews
measures.description: Category review denominator using a distinct-order-key semijoin; category totals are non-additive.
measures.expression: VAR OrdersInCategory = VALUES(FactOrderItems[OrderKey]) RETURN CALCULATE([Total Valid Reviews], KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(OrdersInCategory, FactReviews[OrderKey])))

measures.name: Show Review Top 10 States
measures.description: Visual-only exact Top 10 by selected population volume; alphabetical tie-break. Never apply at page/report level.
measures.expression: VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]), "__Volume", [Total Valid Reviews]), NOT ISBLANK(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) && [__Volume] > 0) VAR Leaders = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Volume], DESC, DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], ASC) VAR CurrentGroup = SELECTEDVALUE(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) RETURN IF(ISINSCOPE(DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState]) && CONTAINS(Leaders, DimCustomerGeography[ApproximateState], CurrentGroup), 1, 0)

measures.name: Show Review Top 10 Categories
measures.description: Visual-only exact Top 10 by selected population volume; alphabetical tie-break. Never apply at page/report level.
measures.expression: VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__Volume", [Category Valid Reviews]), NOT ISBLANK(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) && [__Volume] > 0) VAR Leaders = TOPN(10, Candidates, [__Volume], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) VAR CurrentGroup = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) RETURN IF(ISINSCOPE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) && CONTAINS(Leaders, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentGroup), 1, 0)

tables.name: DimSellerGeography
tables.description: Seller location only. Filters DimSeller and FactOrderItems; does not allocate order payments or reviews to sellers.

tables.name: DimDate
tables.description: Purchase date for all facts. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

columns.name: MonthStartDate
columns.description: First calendar day of each purchase month; supports an uncluttered continuous monthly trend axis.

tables.name: DimApprovalDate
tables.description: Order approval date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimCarrierDate
tables.description: Order handed to carrier date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimActualDeliveryDate
tables.description: Actual order delivery date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimEstimatedDeliveryDate
tables.description: Estimated order delivery date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimShippingLimitDate
tables.description: Shipping deadline for order items. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimReviewCreationDate
tables.description: Review creation date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimReviewAnswerDate
tables.description: Review answer date. Separate active date role; missing dates appear under the relationship blank member.

tables.name: DimOrder
tables.description: One row per order. Shared order selection across all facts, without fact-to-fact relationships.
